item.title: PMFG 2025 Marks Major Milestone for Precision Medicine in Qatar - Sidra Medicine
item.description: The Precision Medicine and the Future of Genomics (PMFG) Summit 2025 successfully concluded after three days of high-level discussions, scientific exchange, and strategic collaboration, new international partnerships = bringing together global leaders, start ups and young scientists in genomics, healthcare innovation, and biomedical research.

item.title: Sidra Medicine Announces the 10th Qatar Pediatric Emergency Medicine International Conference (QPEM 2026) - Sidra Medicine
item.description: Sidra Medicine is pleased to announce the 10th edition of the Qatar Pediatric Emergency Medicine International Conference (QPEM 2026), taking place virtually from 16–18 January 2026. The milestone edition reflects Sidra Medicine’s continued commitment to advancing high-quality, safe, and patient-centred emergency care for children across Qatar and the region.

item.title: Sidra Medicine Performs Qatar’s First Pediatric Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplantation - Sidra Medicine
item.description: Sidra Medicine has successfully completed its first pediatric allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT), marking an important step forward in the hospital’s mission to deliver advanced, life-saving care for children with complex and high-risk conditions.

item.title: Sidra Medicine Announces Regional First in Access to Sepiapterin Treatment for Phenylketonuria (PKU) - Sidra Medicine
item.description: Sidra Medicine has become the first hospital in the Middle East to facilitate access to sepiapterin, an advanced pharmacological treatment for patients living with Phenylketonuria (PKU). With this achievement, Qatar is now the third country globally—after Germany and the United States—to administer sepiapterin through regulated clinical and governance pathways.

item.title: Sidra Medicine and King’s College London Joint Research Sheds Light on Genetic Diversity in Qatar - Sidra Medicine
item.description: Sidra Medicine and King’s College London have produced the most detailed map to date of large-scale genomic differences in the Qatari population. The research, funded by Qatar Research, Development and Innovation Council, provides a clearer picture of the genetic diversity of Arabs and the relationships between genetic variations and health and disease.

item.title: Msheireb Museums and Sidra Medicine Kick Off 2026 Science Café Series on Stem Cells - Sidra Medicine
item.description: Msheireb Museums and Sidra Medicine hosted the first Science Café session of 2026, marking the third year of their collaboration to bring scientific knowledge closer to the public. The session, titled Stem Cells in Precision Medicine: From Research to Reality, took place at Bin Jelmood House, Msheireb Museums, on Wednesday.

item.title: Sidra Medicine Sets a New Benchmark as Only Organisation in Middle East and Europe to Reach HIMSS DIAM Stage 6 - Sidra Medicine
item.description: Sidra Medicine, a member of Qatar Foundation, has reached a significant milestone in its digital transformation journey, with formal validation of achieving Stage 6 in both HIMSS EMRAM and HIMSS DIAM.

item.title: Sidra Medicine and QatarEnergy Sign Memorandum of Understanding - Sidra Medicine
item.description: Sidra Medicine and QatarEnergy have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to set a framework for mutual collaboration across healthcare services, professional development opportunities, and the exchange of expertise.

item.title: Sidra Medicine Highlights Precision Medicine Breakthrough for Rare Genetic Condition - Sidra Medicine
item.description: Sidra Medicine, Qatar’s specialist women’s and children’s hospital and a member of Qatar Foundation, has highlighted the real-world impact of precision medicine on a six year old patient with a rare genetic condition.
